subject: ICT
title: How Many Dots?
subtitle: Count the dots on the dice
hero_picture: A boy and a girl playing snakes and ladders on the floor with a big red dice, red dice tumbling in the air around them.

sections.heading: Snakes and ladders
text: Ravi and Linu play snakes and ladders.
'If it is 6, the snake will swallow!' says Linu.
They roll the dice and count.
sections.caption: Playing snakes and ladders
sections.picture: A boy and a girl playing a snakes-and-ladders board on the floor, the girl rolling a dice.

sections.heading: Dots on a dice
text: The dots tell us the number.
sections.caption: The six faces of a dice
sections.picture: Six red dice in a row showing 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 white dots.

sections.heading: Count quickly
text: Count the dots on the dice.
Can you tell without counting one by one?
sections.caption: Counting dots
sections.picture: A child pointing at each dot on a big red dice, counting the dots.

sections.heading: Numbers with dice
text: Dice fall down from the sky.
Count the dots and type the number before they reach down.
sections.caption: Falling dice game
sections.picture: A laptop screen with a blue sky and red dice falling down towards three fluffy sheep on green grass.

sections.heading: Show with fingers
text: Show the number with your fingers.
sections.caption: Showing fingers
sections.picture: Children playing a counting game, one rolling a dice and others holding up fingers to match the dots.

rhyme: Roll the dice and count the dots,
One, two, three, I count a lot,
Four, five, six, type it in,
Quick, quick, quick, and I win!
activity: Make a dice from a small paper box. Draw dots from 1 to 6 on its sides and play.
talk: How many sides does a dice have?
What is the biggest number on a dice?
How did you count the dots quickly?
summary: A dice has 1 to 6 dots; we count the dots and type the number.

questions.prompt: How many sides does a dice have?
What is the most dots on one side?
In the game, what do we type?
questions.explanation: We type how many dots there are.

questions.prompt: A dice shows 3 dots. Which number?
What game were Ravi and Linu playing?
